review_notes: Segment 0: वाक्य 'यो हि आदित एव सन्यस्य कर्माणि, सन्न्यस्य कर्माणि, ज्ञानयोगनिष्ठायां प्रवृत्तः, यश्च कर्मयोगेन तयोः स्थितप्रज्ञस्य... अजहाति ति आरभ्य अध्यायपरिसमाप्तिपर्यन्तम्।' appears garbled or misrecognized by ASR. I have preserved the wording and adjusted only sentence boundary; please have a human reviewer verify and, if needed, restore the correct Sanskrit/shloka phrasing.

Segment 0: Several minor spacing/sandhi adjustments were made (e.g., 'दुःखेषु अनुद्विग्न मनाः', 'स्थितधीः मुनिरुच्यते') to improve readability; please confirm these match the speaker's intended Sanskrit forms.

Segment 1: Several Sanskrit-looking phrases/verses (e.g., 'पण्डा विद्यते यस्य सः पण्डितः ते पण्डिताः।', 'प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे', 'गत-असून्, अगत-असून्। गतासून् अगतासूंश्च') appear garbled or inconsistent. I did not alter them because a correction could change doctrinal meaning; please have a subject-matter reviewer verify and, if needed, correct the exact Sanskrit/verse text.
Segment 1: The transcript ends mid-sentence ('सांख्य बुद्'); preserved as in raw. Please verify and supply continuation if available.

Segment 4: The Sanskrit phrases around 'दीप शिखा सोई परम प्रचण्डा' and the exact phrasing of the Gosvami quotation were adjusted but remain somewhat uncertain; please verify against the speaker's intended quotation if precise canonical wording is required.
Segment 4: The correction 'सोऽहमस्मि इति' was made with medium confidence; if the speaker quoted a different sandhi/orthography, review may be needed.

Segment 5: Left several Sanskrit or Sanskritized phrases (e.g., 'स्थास्यति निश्चला', 'नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः', 'निराकारम् एव, निराकार एव भवितुमर्हति') as in source because their exact classical forms are uncertain from the ASR; please verify these against the original audio or source text if precise Sanskrit wording is required.
Segment 5: Preserved speaker's Hindi/English code-switching (e.g., 'At the same time', 'at least', 'evaluation', 'suddenly').

Segment 6: The Sanskrit-like phrase 'वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम्' appears garbled/uncertain in transcription; left as in source for accuracy. Please verify against the intended shloka if needed.
Segment 7: Check 'वृत्ता दिनी' (beginning phrase) — possible ASR error or speaker's colloquial term; left unchanged because intended word was unclear.
Segment 7: Verify Sanskrit fragments and verse-phrases left as in raw text, e.g. 'अथ चैनं नित्यजातं' and 'समाधिस्थस्य केशव' — uncertain segmentation/inflections; do not alter without human review.
Segment 7: Confirm the numeral words 'सैंतालीसवाँ और अड़तालीसवाँ' and 'चौवनवें से बहत्तरवें' for accuracy of verse numbers.
Segment 8: Verify the exact Sanskrit phrasing 'यस्य सः स्थितप्रज्ञः' against the speaker's intended reading (possible variants exist in the shloka).
Segment 8: Speaker uses several Sanskrit terms (प्रभाषेत, स्थितधीः, परैः etc.); these were left as in the transcript when uncertain rather than altered.

Segment 9: Sanskrit forms and punctuation (e.g., आसीत्/व्रजेत् visarga, joining of shloka lines) were adjusted for clarity; if a strict canonical orthography is required, please verify the exact traditional rendering.

Segment 10: Several phrases appear garbled or uncertain and may need human review: 'कामनिचित', 'परमार्थ दर्शनामृत रसलाभेन। अन्यस्मादलं प्रत्ययवान्।', and the phrase 'भगवान् श्रीसंपन्न परमात्मा' — these may be ASR artifacts or require verification against the speaker's audio.
Segment 10: Sanskrit shlokas have been preserved as in the raw transcript; no substantive emendations were made to verse text except minor punctuation normalization.
Segment 11: Phrase 'नव विहितान्' (early in segment) is unclear — could be an ASR error or speaker's phrasing; verify against audio.
Segment 11: The Sanskrit phrase 'नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः' should be checked for correct transcription (wording and sandhi).
Segment 11: Quoted line 'प्रजहाति यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्' appears to be a shloka/verse — verify exact wording.
Segment 11: Name 'तपोन्जी महाराज' — confirm correct spelling/pronunciation (तपोञ्जी / तपोन्जी / तपोन् जी).
Segment 11: Place name 'रियाल सरोवर' / 'रियाल सर'—check actual toponym intended (could be 'रिआल सर' or another local name).
Segment 11: Phrases with English code-switching (e.g., 'एटलीस्ट नॉट मी', 'something लग गया', 'एलिजिबल', 'परमिटेड', 'इनविटेशन') are preserved as spoken; confirm if any should be standardized.

Segment 12: Sanskrit fragments and quoted shloka (e.g., 'प्रजहाति... यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्।', 'आत्मन्येव आत्मना एव तुष्टः।', 'स्थितप्रज्ञः कदा उच्यते? यदा तुष्टः') have been left as in the transcript; no attempt was made to normalize or reconstruct canonical readings.
Segment 12: Colloquial usages (e.g., 'लेके', 'बचवा') were preserved in spirit, with a few standardizations to improve readability.

Segment 13: Several Sanskrit/vernacular quotations appear uncertain and could warrant human review: 'आत्मनी सप्तमी है', 'रम रह्या मेरा साईंआँ', 'आपे रसिया, आप रस, आपे रवणहार', and 'प्रारब्ध वायुना'. I preserved the raw renderings where the intended canonical forms were not unambiguous.
Segment 13: Phrase 'आत्मारामः आत्मक्रीडः स्थितप्रज्ञ इत्यर्थः' retained as in raw; if this is a Sanskrit citation, a subject-matter reviewer may want to confirm exact diacritics/word-segmentation.
Segment 14: Phrase 'कमलाहाल' is unclear in context and may be mis-transcribed; left as in original for reviewer verification.
Segment 14: The segment 'सो रावर निज गे' appears garbled/unclear; preserved as in raw transcript but should be checked by a human reviewer.
Segment 14: 'तीस-बत्तीस' and 'चुट्टी' are colloquial/ambiguous in this context; left unchanged but may merit verification against audio.
Segment 15: Sanskrit fragment 'तस्मात् आत्मगं ह्यर्चयेत् भूतिकामः' retained as in raw text; transcription is unclear and may need Sanskrit specialist review before any correction.
Segment 15: 'तुष्टः नव' preserved from raw; uncertain whether the speaker said 'तुष्टः न वा' or another form — please verify.
Segment 15: The Sanskrit/quoted items 'किं प्रभाषेत, किम् आसीत' were left as in raw; if a canonical rendering is intended, confirm exact forms before any change.
